name: Chicken Fajita Pasta
description: An innovative fusion of Mexican fajitas and Italian pasta, combining spiced chicken and vegetables with creamy cheese sauce for a flavorful, hearty meal.

steps.title: Boil the Pasta
instructions: Fill a pot with water and add a heavy pinch of salt.
Bring the water to a boil.
Add the bowtie pasta to the boiling water.
Boil the pasta for five minutes.
Drain the pasta.
Set the pasta aside.

steps.title: Prepare the Vegetables
instructions: Finely chop the yellow, red, and orange bell peppers.
Remove seeds from the peppers before chopping.
Finely chop the red onion.
Chop the spinach into small pieces.
Set all chopped vegetables aside.

steps.title: Cook the Vegetables
instructions: Place the same pot back on the stove over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot.
Add the chopped bell peppers and onion.
Sauté until the onion is slightly translucent, about 5 to 8 minutes.
Add the chopped spinach to the pot.
Add one packet of taco seasoning.
Stir to combine the vegetables and seasoning.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
Add the chicken cubes to the pot with the vegetables.
Cook for 5 to 8 minutes, or until the chicken is browned and fully cooked.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
instructions: Add the cream cheese block to the chicken and vegetables.
Add 1/4 cup of heavy whipping cream.
Turn the heat to medium-low.
Stir continuously until the cream cheese melts and combines with the mixture.

steps.title: Add the Cheese
instructions: Add small handfuls of shredded Mexican-style cheese to the pot.
Pour in the milk gradually while stirring.
Continue stirring until the sauce reaches the desired creamy consistency.

steps.title: Combine the Pasta
instructions: Add the second packet of taco seasoning to the pot.
Stir until everything is evenly combined.
Gradually add the cooked bowtie pasta to the sauce.
Stir well to coat the pasta with the sauce.

steps.title: Finish and Serve
instructions: Turn off the heat.
Let the pasta sit for 3 to 5 minutes to thicken.
Serve the Chicken Fajita Pasta warm.
